tools.name: list_consultation_slots
tools.description: List available 60-minute paid AI-consultation slots with Akshay Shetty (EUR 500, timezone Europe/Tallinn). Returns ISO-8601 UTC start times to pass to request_consultation.

tools.name: request_consultation
tools.description: Reserve a consultation slot and get a secure Stripe payment link. The booking is only CONFIRMED once the human completes the EUR 500 payment at the returned checkout_url — nothing is charged automatically and an unpaid hold expires in ~30 minutes.
